mailbox — mail, calendars, todos and contacts

USAGE
  mailbox <command> [flags]

MAIL
  box           The mail in a box
  message       One message, read whole
  thread        A whole conversation
  search        Search every box
  compose       Write and send a mail
  reply         Answer, in its thread
  forward       Send a message on
  draft         Mail written but not sent
  outbox        What is queued to go out
  attachment    The files a message carries

ORGANIZE
  screener      Senders waiting for a decision
  route         Where a sender's mail goes
  aside         The read-later pile
  reply-later   The reply-later pile
  bubble        Bubble a thread back later
  label         Labels on mail
  move          Move mail to another box
  seen          Mark mail read
  unseen        Mark mail unread
  trash         Move mail to Trash
  spam          Move mail to Junk

CALENDAR & TASKS & CONTACTS
  agenda        What is on
  calendar      The calendars and task lists
  event         One entry, and when it repeats
  todo          The task lists
  habit         The daily practices
  contact       The address books

SYSTEM
  status        What the mirror holds
  daemon        Run the daemon in the foreground
  setup         Set up this machine
  doctor        Find what is not working
  sieve         Scripts on the server
  commands      Machine command index
  version       Installed version

HELP TOPICS
  ids           How mail and entries are named
  exit-codes    What an exit status means
  environment   The variables that are read
  architecture  How a command is answered

FLAGS
  --json        print the response envelope

Ids are [account/]box:uid — 36722, Screener:342, gmx/INBOX:412.

  mailbox <command> --help   one command
  mailbox help <topic>       a topic above
